def update_signature_args(sig: inspect.Signature, arg_types: Dict[str, type
    ], has_self: bool, existing_annotation_strategy:
    ExistingAnnotationStrategy=ExistingAnnotationStrategy.REPLICATE
    ) ->inspect.Signature:
    """Update argument annotations with the supplied types"""
    new_params = []
    for i, param in enumerate(sig.parameters.values()):
        # Skip annotating 'self' or 'cls' for instance/class methods
        if has_self and i == 0:
            new_params.append(param)
            continue
        
        # Check if we have a traced type for this parameter
        if param.name not in arg_types:
            new_params.append(param)
            continue
        
        traced_type = arg_types[param.name]
        existing_anno = param.annotation
        
        if existing_annotation_strategy == ExistingAnnotationStrategy.REPLICATE:
            # Keep existing annotations, only add if not present
            if existing_anno is not inspect.Parameter.empty:
                new_params.append(param)
            else:
                if traced_type is not None:
                    new_param = param.replace(annotation=traced_type)
                    new_params.append(new_param)
                else:
                    new_params.append(param)
        elif existing_annotation_strategy == ExistingAnnotationStrategy.IGNORE:
            # Override with traced types, ignore existing annotations
            if traced_type is not None:
                new_param = param.replace(annotation=traced_type)
                new_params.append(new_param)
            else:
                # traced_type is None, remove annotation
                new_param = param.replace(annotation=inspect.Parameter.empty)
                new_params.append(new_param)
        elif existing_annotation_strategy == ExistingAnnotationStrategy.OMIT:
            # Remove annotations where they already exist in source
            if existing_anno is not inspect.Parameter.empty:
                # Existing annotation present, remove it
                new_param = param.replace(annotation=inspect.Parameter.empty)
                new_params.append(new_param)
            else:
                # No existing annotation, add traced type if available
                if traced_type is not None:
                    new_param = param.replace(annotation=traced_type)
                    new_params.append(new_param)
                else:
                    new_params.append(param)
    
    return sig.replace(parameters=new_params)
